desc: rebind SR-IOV virtual functions to their driver
u: netplan-rebind - rebind SR-IOV virtual functions to their driver
netplan rebind [interfaces] rebinds SR-IOV virtual functions of given physical functions to their driver.

<dl><dt data-o="">-h, --help</dt><dd>Print basic help.</dd><dt data-o="">--debug</dt><dd>Print debugging output during the process.</dd><dt>interfaces</dt><dd>Space separated list of PF interface names.</dd></dl>
